A creative asset review and approval platform for agencies and creative teams. Features a 4-column Kanban board (Concepts/In Review/Approved/Revisions), asset management with version history, threaded comment system with resolve/unresolve workflow, client directory, deadline tracking with overdue alerts, analytics dashboard with SVG charts, JSON export/import, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 3 clients and 6 creative assets across logos, banners, videos, and photography.

Real-time product analytics SaaS for SaaS teams and indie makers. Features live event streaming with 9 event types, multi-step funnel analysis with conversion rates, session tracking (Active/Abandoned/Converted), user analytics with plan tiers and event counts, analytics dashboard with custom SVG bar and donut charts, JSON export/import, dark theme UI, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 14 events, 6 sessions, 6 users, and 2 funnels.

A sleek time tracking and productivity analytics SaaS with live start/stop/pause timer, color-coded project and task management, daily/weekly goal tracking with visual progress bars, weekly bar chart, project distribution pie chart, productivity score, weekly summary with streak tracking, and 100% localStorage persistence.

A customer health dashboard SaaS for CS teams and account managers. Features a full customer list with health scores, NPS, ARR, and last active tracking. Score breakdown across login frequency, NPS, recency, and engagement. Activity feed per customer with timestamps. Internal notes with date stamps. Alert banner for at-risk accounts. Segment filtering and search. Side panel customer detail with score bars. Add/edit customer modal. 100% localStorage persistence.
